Well wait, wait, wait. I was a big shot quicker than you because I was in it. Don't forget, you didn't appear until series 2.
If we'd split the atom, they would invite..
..both of us, not just the guy who does the press conference.

q: Aged about twelve, Ricky swam out to rescue a toddler whose little boat had drifted out to sea. What did the grateful mother give him?

s: The Ricky Gervais Guide to The English · 2009
ex: I thought of something then, when I was a kid on the beach there was a baby. Like a toddler, I was about twelve and they were out - their little boat had gone out, the mother missed it and they were miles out and the mother was sort of…
It's not enough, a box of chocolates. I'd have been furious.
I would have wanted a lot more.

q: Ricky said his girlfriend, aged seven or eight, once called her mum a very rude four-letter word. What did she think it meant?

ex: My, my, uhm, girlfriend, when she was about… seven or eight, she was walking to school with her mum, and she called her a c-u-n… right?

No, she said, “Oh, you’re a…” ‘cause she thought it was a big, she said she thought it was a big furry animal. She thou—so she was being nice and her mum went, “Where’d you hear that? Where’d you hear that?”
“Just heard it at school.” So they, you know, they might not know what it means.

Cheeky, really. I mean, on the way to the hospital, so.
Because I was not an ambulance driver.
I was in that sort of thing where you just can't be bothered. Do you know what I mean? It was in a sweat and he.
Came back with a scratch card and some barbecue briquettes.

Yeah. So anyway, he gets us there and he doesn't charge us, which is pretty decent. So I go in and he's like, I don't know if you've been in like A E at like half two in the morning. It's just depressing. Fluorescent light doesn't help…

I love the fact that Simon Schama has never started a program--
Like that. Uh, (Simon Schama Impression) "The- The Jacobites. We've talked a lot about hairy kids..."

And he's a giant, and he gets - starts of little and gets bigger.
Little by little. Well, 'Bigger By Bigger' I would've called it.
Yeah, yeah. Well, that's what makes you a genius.

Yeah, I go- I try and get 'em, try and get 'em all summat.
So, uhh, I got a lift down, and I thought, "Oh what can I get?" I thought, "oh I can't just give them the money, I can't-"

I've mentioned to m- to you that my grandparents spend all their time in bed. So there's only so many kind of, you know, sort of, bed socks you can buy. You know, and- and ointment for, you know, bed blisters, and so on before, you know…
Could you get 'em- what about some of those novelty teeth?
'Cause that- I mean- 'cause that would be, you know, a nice jokey present...
...and they could probably come in useful

How fast a tractor can actually go

What sort of person lives in a haystack?
Maybe they don't live in it, maybe they were just saying you that's 'your haystack'...
Well, yes, they're probably a farm owner.

Poltergeist’s going, “Ohhh, I’m just making this room messy. I wish someone would open the door so I could…” Go on.

q: Karl's Auntie Nora won't have a doorbell because it makes her jump too much. What was Ricky's solution?

A glass door she can watch through
A dog that barks when visitors arrive

The knocking is fine, because you get to know knocks.
Why don't they have a bell, but when you press it, it makes that noise? (knocks on table)
Because they haven't done that yet.
Well, you could do. You could do a sample of a (knocks) like that, so when they press the doorbell, she hears (knocks). That's easy. That's done. You could sort that out for her.
Well I don't want to start getting dragged into it because...
But why don't you tell her? Say "Auntie Nora, have double glazing! Be warm, be safe! Hear the knock of the bell on the doubley door!" (knocks)

q: Karl thinks you should try speaking the local language when abroad. What's Ricky's technique?

Get Steve to order for him

And if they don’t get it, I go mental.
Secure in the fact that I’ve tried my best and they’re having a laugh.
And that is the prerogative of all Englishmen.

Someone was under and he, sort of, you know, went a little bit crazy.

It’s that sort of thing, like, well, you want to play it for someone and then you want them to go, “My God, you’re deep.”

So now- so now he's cold and sick?

Unless there was, sort of spirits and that in the lift. They couldn't have got closer. Alright? So I turn up. You're not there.

And--and, and operating the desk. I thought, "I'm gonna... Even if I get through operating the desk, I'm gonna swear." And it just, oh, it was--it was just awful.
